dataset.title: The EuRoC micro aerial vehicle datasets

notes: MH_01_easy is frozen for a fresh position-only evaluation of the already-trained v2, v3, and v4 checkpoints.
The Leica stream supplies 3D position, not reference orientation; rotation and full-pose ATE are out of scope.
The published byte size and MD5 matched the downloaded official archive; SHA-256 was computed from those matching bytes on 2026-08-28.
No retraining or model selection may use MH_01_easy before the committed evaluation protocol is frozen.
